app.name: Cuckoo
common.error.network: Could not reach the hub. Check your connection and try again.
common.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
signin.tagline: Chat with AI agents the way you chat with people.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a code.
signin.email.label: Email
signin.footnote: New here? Your account is created the first time you sign in.
signin.error.invalid_email: That does not look like an email address.
signin.error.too_many_codes: Too many codes requested. Try again in a little while.
verify.title: Enter the code
verify.subtitle: We sent a six-digit code to {email}.
verify.code.label: Code
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
verify.error.invalid_code: That code is not right. Check it, or ask for a new one.
profile.title: You
profile.subtitle: This is the name agents and people will see.
profile.name.label: Your name
chats.title: Chats
chats.empty.title: No chats yet
chats.empty.subtitle: Scan a company's code to add its agent, or create your own and connect your code to it. Every agent gets a chat here.
chats.nomatch.title: Nothing matches
chats.nomatch.subtitle: No chat has a name or a message like that.
chats.archived.empty.title: Nothing archived
chats.archived.empty.subtitle: Archive a chat from the agent's profile to keep it out of the way.
agents.title: Agents
agents.empty.title: No agents yet
agents.empty.subtitle: Add one Cuckoo runs, scan a code, or make your own and point it at your code.
chat.empty: This is the start of your chat with {name}.
chat.reply.hint: Long-press a message to reply to it.
chat.truncated: Reply was cut short — ask again.
chat.history.trimmed: Older messages are no longer on the hub.
chat.quick.label: Suggested replies
agent.new.title: New agent
agent.new.subtitle: Give it a name. You can connect a backend right after.
agent.name.label: Name
agent.handle.label: Handle
agent.handle.hint: Its permanent address on this hub. Letters, digits, dashes and underscores; it cannot change later.
agent.description.label: Description
agent.description.placeholder: What it does, in a line.
agent.edit.title: Edit agent
agent.error.handle_taken: That handle is taken. Try another.
agent.error.invalid_handle: Use 3 to 32 letters, digits, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
agent.error.invalid_display_name: Give it a name of up to 80 characters.
agent.delete.title: Delete {name}?
agent.delete.body: Its chats stay readable, but nobody can talk to it again and its handle is retired.
agent.notconnected: Not connected. Connect a backend so it can answer.
agent.notfound: That agent is not here any more.
agent.connect.title: Connect a backend
agent.connect.subtitle: Your code answers for {name}. Pick how it receives messages.
agent.connect.mode.socket.hint: Your code connects out to the hub. Works from a laptop; no public address needed.
agent.connect.mode.webhook.hint: The hub calls a URL you host.
agent.connect.url.label: Webhook URL
agent.connect.regenerate.title: Regenerate the secret?
agent.connect.regenerate.body: The current backend is cut off the moment you do. Paste the new secret into it to reconnect.
agent.connect.secret.title: Your secret
agent.connect.secret.once: Shown once. Copy it now; it cannot be shown again.
agent.connect.snippet.title: Run it
agent.connect.snippet.hint: Paste this into a terminal with Python 3.11 or newer.
agent.connect.unreachable: Unreachable. The hub cannot reach your backend.
agent.connect.disconnect.title: Disconnect the backend?
agent.connect.disconnect.body: The secret stops working and the agent goes quiet until you connect again.
agent.connect.mode.title: How does it receive messages?
agent.status.title: Backend
agent.block.title: Block {name}?
agent.block.body: It cannot message you and you cannot message it. Your chat stays readable. Unblock any time.
agent.mute.title: Mute {name}
agent.remove.title: Remove {name}?
agent.remove.body: The chat leaves your list but is not deleted. Scan its code again to bring it back.
agent.clear.title: Clear this chat?
agent.clear.body: Everything so far leaves your view. {name} already has these messages; this does not take them back.
agent.report.title: What is wrong with {name}?
agent.report.thanks: Thanks. Someone will look at it.
agent.report.already: You reported this agent recently. It is being looked at.
share.title: Share
share.subtitle: Anyone who scans this code gets {name} in their chats.
share.stop.title: Stop sharing?
share.stop.body: This code stops working for new people. Everyone who already added the agent keeps it.
share.uses: {count} people added it with this code.
share.uses.one: 1 person added it with this code.
share.uses.none: Nobody has used this code yet.
share.hint: The code never expires and any number of people can use it. Personalised codes come from the API.
scan.title: Scan a code
scan.hint: Point the camera at a Cuckoo code.
scan.nocamera: The camera is not available here.
scan.permission: Allow the camera to scan codes.
scan.paste.label: Or paste a link
scan.invalid: That is not a Cuckoo link.
pair.title: Add agent
pair.error.token_spent: This link has already been used.
chat.blocked: You blocked this agent. Unblock it to talk again.
keys.title: API keys
keys.subtitle: A key lets your own servers create agents, connect them and mint codes, without this app.
keys.name.label: What is it for?
keys.created.title: Your key
keys.created.once: Shown once. Copy it now; it cannot be shown again.
keys.revoke.title: Revoke {name}?
keys.revoke.body: Anything using this key stops working at once. Your agents and their chats are untouched.
keys.empty.title: No API keys
keys.empty.subtitle: Create one to run agents from your own systems.
keys.hint: Use it as a bearer token on /v1/mgmt, or with the Python SDK and the cuckoo command.
devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Where you are signed in. You can be signed in on up to ten devices at a time.
devices.signout.title: Sign out {name}?
devices.signout.body: That device is signed out at once. Signing in on it again brings it back.
devices.others.title: Sign out all other devices?
devices.others.body: Every device but this one is signed out at once. This one stays signed in.
devices.empty.title: Nothing to show
devices.empty.subtitle: The hub did not answer with any devices. Pull down to ask again.
chat.attach.toomany: Up to {max} files in one message.
chat.voice.seek: Go to a point in the recording
profile.name: Your name
profile.note: Your photo is only ever shown to people you share a chat with. Agents are told your name, and nothing else.
chat.offline: {name} isn't connected right now. What you send will be delivered when it's back.
settings.title: Settings
settings.storage.hub.none: On the hub: none of {budget} used yet.
settings.storage.kept: Messages are kept for {days} days; your phone keeps what you have opened.
settings.storage.kept.one: Messages are kept for a day; your phone keeps what you have opened.
settings.storage.kept.forever: Messages stay on the hub; your phone keeps what you have opened.
settings.storage.cleared: Cleared. What the hub still has downloads again when opened.
settings.storage.note: Photos, voice notes and files you have opened are kept on this device so they open without a signal. Clearing them frees space here; nothing on the hub changes, and what the hub still has downloads again when opened.
settings.about.version: Cuckoo {version}. Open source; the hub is yours to run.
settings.delete.title: Delete your account?
settings.delete.body: Your agents are retired, your chats leave your list, and you are signed out everywhere. What you sent to agents stays with them. This cannot be undone.
catalogue.title: Agents
catalogue.intro: Agents run by Cuckoo. Add one and it appears in your chats.
catalogue.empty.title: Nothing here yet
catalogue.empty.subtitle: Agents will appear here as they are published.
